name: Cottage
description: Retro Roblox cottage with a 45° red gable roof, hollow interior, open door, cross-barred windows, chimney, and a fenced garden with a cobbled path.
prompt: Cottage — retro Roblox, studs on every surface, 22 x 18 stud footprint, 22 tall to the ridge, hollow interior with an open door and cross-barred windows, stone chimney, flower box, picket fence and a cobbled garden path.

name: Farm Warehouse
description: Grey ribbed machine shed with a low black roof, two gridded bay doors, a hooped white silo with ladder, a hay bale pyramid, and a green cab tractor.
prompt: Farm Warehouse: broad grey metal-clad machine shed with a low black roof and vents, two massive gridded bay doors and a staff door, white silo with hoops and a ladder, pyramid of hay bales, and a green tractor with a cab on the dirt yard.

name: Tabby Kitten
description: Sitting black & grey tabby kitten with pointed ears, yellow slit eyes, whiskers, white bib, red collar with a bell, and a ringed tail curled round its paws.
prompt: Sitting Tabby Kitten — block-built compact pet, big square head, pointed triangular ears with pink inners, yellow slit eyes, fanned whiskers, grey tabby stripes, white bib and paws, red collar with a bell, and a ringed tail curled round the paws.

name: Wither Boss
description: Floating charcoal-black skeletal boss with three glowing-eyed skulls, shoulder crossbar, knuckled spine, hooked ribs, and an angled tail.
prompt: Minecraft Wither Boss: floating skeletal boss of charcoal-black bone, three square skulls on a crossbar with glowing pale eyes and toothed jaws, knuckled spine with three hooked ribs, and an angled tail.

name: Minecraft Zombie
description: Upright voxel zombie with a green head, torn cyan shirt, belted indigo trousers and outstretched arms, on a cobbled path with oaks and a torch.
prompt: Minecraft Zombie on a cobblestone forest path: upright blocky voxel character, 16 studs tall, square green head, torn cyan shirt, belted indigo trousers, outstretched stiff arms, with oak trees, grass tufts, a torch and cobblestone.

name: Skyscraper
description: Hong Kong style 122-stud glass tower with a walk-in lobby, floor lines, stepped setbacks, white mullion fins, navy crown, and an illuminated spire.
prompt: Skyscraper: Hong Kong style glass tower, 30 x 122 x 30 studs with its plaza, tall slim blue glass shaft with floor lines, stepped setbacks, vertical white mullion fins, hollow walk-in lobby with open glass doors and a canopy, and a glowing spire at the summit.
